chapter.title: Zlatko
chapter.note: Rebuilt on 6 November 2026 to the PowerPyx 100% chart (78 boxes, two bracketed phases, five endings) and the game’s text (template 17-zlatko: two prompts, two public-opinion arrows; string table MENU.FLOWCHART.05K.*). LOOK FOR HELP → MEET ZLATKO → the basement and the machine: ESCAPE BEFORE BEING RESET (a risk roll) or KARA IS RESET. Escape: FREE MONSTERS in the basement, SNEAK THROUGH HOUSE, then [SEARCH HOUSE FOR ALICE]. Reset: OBEY YOUR NEW MASTER, the tray and the torso, then [EXPLORE THE HOUSE TO RECOVER MEMORY] (11 memories, six of them gated on A New Home, Fugitives and On the Run; five recover her), then the search. Luther’s ten minutes are ten action scenes shared by both phases; running out ends in KARA REMAINED RESET or LUTHER BROUGHT ALICE TO ZLAKTO. Side branches on both paths: the storage room and the bear, the bathroom android (SHUT DOWN / ALICE / DEAL / SPARE), three magazines, the TV (public opinion small down for the chase or uniform-robbery report). ALICE FOUND → the hiding route through the main room, bedroom, corridor, bathroom (the android alerts Zlatko unless shut down) and storage room, or SET FIRE TO HOUSE; GET SPOTTED → CHASE STARTED ends in ZLATKO KILLED KARA IN THE BATHROOM or IN THE STORAGE ROOM when lost. The yard: LUTHER KILLS ZLATKO or THE MONSTERS AMBUSH ZLATKO → LUTHER JOINS KARA & ALICE. Researched in docs/research/ch17-zlatko.md.

decisions.title: Answer Alice’s bad feeling
decisions.context: On the way to the basement Alice whispers: “I don’t like this place, and that man. Let’s go, I have a bad feeling…”

options.label: CAREFUL
options.effect: “I know. I don’t trust him either… We have to be careful…”

options.label: REASSURE
options.effect: “It’ll be okay, Alice. He’s going to remove my Tracker and then we can start over again in Canada.”

options.label: COMFORT
options.effect: “He’s a bit odd… but I think we can trust him.”

options.label: NO CHOICE
options.effect: “Alice, we have nowhere else to go… We have to trust him.”

decisions.gate: Chapter start, after Time to Decide, with Kara and Alice alive.
decisions.note: The template’s PROMPT 1; no arrow on any option.

benchmark.note: Four game labels, spoken lines in the outcomes, no stat change. Arrival and basement are the events K10a and K10c.

decisions.title: Escape the reset or let it finish?
decisions.context: Strapped into Zlatko’s machine, Kara watches MEMORY WIPE PROGRESS climb. Alice has been carried away.

options.label: ESCAPE BEFORE BEING RESET
options.effect: Knock the red cart into the lamp and the green cable onto the vodka; free before the wipe ends. SNEAK THROUGH HOUSE; the ten minutes start upstairs.

options.label: KARA IS RESET
options.effect: Do nothing (or be too slow): OBEY YOUR NEW MASTER, serve Zlatko, then recover memories before the ten minutes run out.

decisions.note: No source gives the gauge’s duration.

benchmark.note: The escape is a risk roll (0.15, unsourced) whose failure is KARA IS RESET; doing nothing resets her. The old automatic recovery after a failed escape is gone.

decisions.title: Free the caged androids?
decisions.context: Androids Zlatko has mutilated plead from the basement cells: “Help us…”

options.label: FREE MONSTERS
options.effect: They ambush Zlatko in the yard (THE MONSTERS AMBUSH ZLATKO) and can reappear at the recall center.

options.label: Leave them
options.effect: Luther kills Zlatko in the yard (LUTHER KILLS ZLATKO).

decisions.gate: Either path: in the basement after the escape, or as an action in the house after the reset.

benchmark.note: Sets monstersFreed. Escape path: once, on the way out of the basement (K11). Reset path: house option 24, with the template’s reset-path lines.

decisions.title: Recover memory before the ten minutes run out
decisions.context: Reset, Kara serves Zlatko. Luther will bring Alice to him in ten minutes. Objects in the house can bring memories back.

options.label: RECOLLECT ENOUGH MEMORIES
options.effect: MEMORY RECOVERED; the search for Alice begins with the time left.

options.label: LOSE TOO MUCH TIME
options.effect: LUTHER BRINGS ALICE TO ZLAKTO → KARA REMAINED RESET (no-entry ending): Kara stays as his servant.

decisions.note: 11 memories: monsters’ cell, door hole, discussion with Zlatko, offering coat, changing appearance; conditional: Alice’s book (A New Home), Todd’s red ice pipe (rewash, A New Home), squat fireplace and rA9 symbols (Fugitives), news flash (chased or robbed), escape (AX400 magazine, evaded in On the Run). PowerPyx: “You shouldn’t need more than six.”

benchmark.note: One repeatable clue hub with a ten-action budget (one action = one minute; the ten is the game’s). Five memories recover her (unsourced). Inputs: upstairs.book, downstairs.rewash, shelter, ch10RalphCarving (else the squat), chase, robbery/clothes.

decisions.title: Search the house for Alice
decisions.context: Escaped, or with her memory back, Kara searches the upper floor before Luther takes Alice to Zlatko.

options.label: CHECK FIREPLACE EMBERS, CHECK TV, CHECK EMPTY SHOTGUN, RA9
options.effect: Optional clues; the TV report lowers public opinion (small) if it is the highway chase (only after escaping over the freeway in On the Run) or the uniform hold-up.

options.label: READ “ARCTIC TENSIONS”, “ANDROIDS ALTER BRAIN”, “AX400 ON THE RUN”
options.effect: Magazines in the bedroom; the second if Kara escaped over the freeway in On the Run (PowerPyx), the third if Kara evaded the police.

options.label: ALICE FOUND
options.effect: The hunt through the house begins.

options.label: OUT OF TIME
options.effect: LUTHER BROUGHT ALICE TO ZLAKTO (no-entry ending): Zlatko destroys Kara.

decisions.gate: ESCAPE BEFORE BEING RESET or MEMORY RECOVERED.
decisions.note: PowerPyx: ten minutes is “more than enough”.

benchmark.note: The same repeatable hub; every optional action fits in the ten minutes on the escape path. One TV report per run (the chase over a robbery).

decisions.title: The android in the bathtub
decisions.context: A damaged android in the bathroom insists he must tell the Master. Later, if still running, he alerts Zlatko as Kara and Alice sneak through.

options.label: SHUT DOWN
options.effect: He is off for good; no alert later.

options.label: ALICE
options.effect: “A little girl? No, no, no, I haven’t seen her.”

options.label: DEAL
options.effect: “Yes, yes, I promise to be quiet.” He alerts Zlatko anyway.

options.label: SPARE
options.effect: “No… No, of course not…” He alerts Zlatko later.

options.label: KILL / SPARE (BATHROOM ANDROID ALERTS ZLATKO)
options.effect: Silence him or let him be while Zlatko may hear.

decisions.gate: ENTER BATHROOM on either path; the alert on the way out if he was not shut down.
decisions.note: The template’s PROMPT 2; the alert’s KILL / SPARE is a QTE in the game.

benchmark.note: PROMPT 2 is offered in the action right after entering (ALICE only once Kara remembers her). The alert scene’s two options carry the same unsourced risk of being spotted.

decisions.title: Free the polar bear?
decisions.context: An android polar bear is caged in the storage room.

options.label: FREE THE BEAR
options.effect: In the house, before the hunt; it later attacks Zlatko and protects Kara.

options.label: OPEN BEAR CAGE
options.effect: Second chance while sneaking through the storage room; storming the cage risks being spotted.

options.label: Leave it caged
options.effect: ZLATKO KILLED KARA IN THE STORAGE ROOM becomes possible.

decisions.gate: ENTER STORAGE ROOM (escape) or after dropping the torso (reset); OPEN BEAR CAGE only if still caged.
decisions.note: Zlatko shoots the bear twice when it attacks him.

benchmark.note: ch17Bear. With the bear free, the storage-room scene is skipped and “Stay hidden” is offered when Zlatko closes in.

decisions.title: How to get out of the house?
decisions.context: Alice is gone from her room; Zlatko and Luther search the house.

options.label: HIDE UNDER TABLE / HIDE IN CLOSET / ENTER BEDROOM
options.effect: Sneak on through the bedroom (HIDE UNDER BED / HIDE IN CLOSET), the corridor and the bathroom to the storage room.

options.label: SET FIRE TO HOUSE
options.effect: BURNING DOWN THE HOUSE: the hunt ends and everyone is forced outside; The Pirates’ Cove reports the fire.

options.label: GO THROUGH CORRIDOR
options.effect: Straight to the stairs.

options.label: RUN OUT / PUSH AWAY / THROW
options.effect: ZLATKO CLOSES IN in the storage room: LEAVE HIDING SPOT to the stairs.

options.label: GET SPOTTED
options.effect: CHASE STARTED: the stairs, the bear’s protection, or ZLATKO KILLED KARA IN THE BATHROOM / IN THE STORAGE ROOM.

benchmark.note: Each risky move is one roll: failure is GET SPOTTED, and the same roll under half the risk loses the chase. All risk values unsourced. Fire carries no risk and leads to the yard; it sets fire.

decisions.title: The yard: Luther joins Kara and Alice
decisions.context: Zlatko catches up in the yard; Luther steps between them: “No… Not this time…”

options.label: LUTHER KILLS ZLATKO
options.effect: Monsters not freed.

options.label: THE MONSTERS AMBUSH ZLATKO
options.effect: Monsters freed.

options.label: LUTHER JOINS KARA & ALICE
options.effect: Automatic (the ACCEPT / REFUSE prompt is cut). Luther travels with them into The Pirates’ Cove.

decisions.note: The chapter’s one ending without an icon.

benchmark.note: Sets luther and lutherWith; no relationship change.
